modules.vocal-tract-frame.text.configura: Configuration frames default to 0.2 seconds, minimum 0.05 seconds. Positive VOT controls aspiration; negative VOT controls prevoicing in closure. Legacy aspiration frames remain readable. Normal frames transition; the last dwells. Silence moves smoothly to the next posture without sound; final silence holds posture. Drag cards to reorder. The unpaged list has no posture-count limit;
modules.vocal-tract-frame.text.playback_: Playback and video export total at most 60 seconds per sequence
modules.vocal-tract-frame.text.add_keyfr: Add keyframes or generate an IPA sequence before drawing fundamental frequency and pressure.
modules.vocal-tract-frame.text.vocal_tra: Vocal-tract geometry is generated by VocalTractLab 2.4's JD2 or W02 model. Old configurations are recomputed with the current model. Floor attachment is fixed to the jaw while the ventral endpoint moves. This approximation draws on Mills et al. 2019 (doi:10.1002/ca.23343) and 2020 (doi:10.1155/2020/1820978) interpretations of dynamic tissue folds; attachment position is a model setting. The page shows organ surfaces, geometric/synthesis areas, and transfer functions for one configuration. Tongue-position range and independent glottal height are project extensions; ranges describe model adjustability. Acoustic area corrections apply at some constrictions; mesh face count affects display detail.
modules.vocal-tract-frame.text.external_: External head shell: byzmod3d, 3D Human Parts Pack, CC0. Registered schematically for appearance; acoustic calculations use the selected vocal-tract model.
modules.vocal-tract-frame.text.nasal_cav: Nasal cavity: Brüning et al., 2020, average healthy nasal-cavity data v4 (CC BY 4.0). All original mesh triangles are retained, coordinates transformed, and registered to JD2 as independent anatomical reference. Dashed sections indicate a neighboring nasal reference 5 mm off midline.
modules.vocal-tract-frame.text.velum_and: Velum and uvula are reconstructed from native configuration and dorsal tissue thickness; 2D contours are cut from 3D surfaces.
modules.vocal-tract-frame.text.dynamic_m: Dynamic MRI study of nasal vowels ↗
modules.vocal-tract-frame.text.the_vtl_g: The VTL geometric glottal source controls phonation through glottal shape and movement. Formants are peaks of the transfer function; measure recording formants with Praat in Parameter estimation.
modules.vocal-tract-frame.text.fundament: Fundamental frequency and driving pressure · posture timeline
modules.vocal-tract-frame.text.mp4_30_fr: MP4 · 30 frames/s · current view 1280 × 720, six views 1920 × 1080. Includes synchronized audio, keyframe names, and F0.
modules.vocal-tract-frame.text.overlappi: Overlapping offsets add. For fixed-value conflicts, the last added wins; offsets then add and clip to limits. Frame ranges follow reordering; time ranges retain seconds.
modules.vocal-tract-frame.text.recompute: Recompute with current geometry before importing
